newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA'S SAA CLOSE TO B.MIDLAND, THAI AIR TIE-UPS.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA'S SAA CLOSE TO B.MIDLAND, THAI AIR TIE-UPS.

text.p: State-owned South African Airways (SAA) said on Wednesday it was close to adding to its network of global alliances by sealing deals with British Midland and Thai Airways International .
"We are close to concluding two further agreements, with Thai Airways International and British Midland," SAA chief executive Mike Myburgh said in a statement.
SAA already has link-ups with Germany's Lufthansa , American Airlines and SA Express.

Myburgh said the closer cooperation with Thai Airways would see the firm adjusting its Far East operations, including developing the Thai capital of Bangkok as its regional hub. The firm also plans to add Japan to its network next April.
The changes will mean SAA's existing flights to Singapore will stop operating on October 26 and the tiny Asian state will then be served in association with Thai Airways via Bangkok.
"As our relationship with Thai Airways International develops, we will be announcing further service improvements to the Far East route," Myburgh said.
SAA already has a frequent flyer fare agreement with Thai Airways and Midland, an SAA spokesman said.
He declined to comment on any details of the possible agreement with British Midland, a regional European airline. But added that an announcement was expected in November.
